test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 14 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Rajiv scored 20 percent marks in an exam and failed by 25 marks. If he scores 50 percent marks, then he gets 20 marks more than passing marks. What is the passing marks for the exam?
solution:
Given:

Rajiv scored 20% marks in an exam and failed by 25 marks.

If he scored 50% marks, then he gets 20 marks more than passing marks.

Formula used:

Percentage = (value/total value) × 100

Calculation:

Let the total marks be x

According to the question,

⇒ (20x/100) + 25 = (50x/100) – 20

⇒ 3x/10 = 45

⇒ x = 150

Thus, Total marks = 150

Passing marks = {(50/100) × 150} – 20

⇒ 75 – 20

⇒ 55

∴ The passing mark for the exam is 55.
